title: fix(app-shell): resolve a report's inline locale label and description to the viewer's language (objectui#13470)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D1XH3Stf1pdUctjJez54hAZ)_

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)

Fixes #13470
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

`ReportSchema` in `@objectstack/spec` types a report's `label` and `description` as `I18nLabel`, so an inline locale map such as `{ 'zh-CN', en }` is valid metadata, and the `/meta` read serves it unchanged. Four places on the report route drew it raw:

- `ReportView`'s page heading (`previewReport.title || previewReport.label`) and the line under it (`previewReport.description`). React refused the object as a child (error #31) and the page was blank for every viewer, the card's repro.
- The app bar's report crumb in `AppHeader`. It handed the served label to `reportLabel` as its fallback, and `reportLabel` returns an unmatched fallback untouched, so the map reached JSX there too. With `ReportView` fixed alone, the page stayed blank through this crumb (measured: the ablation below).
- The drill drawer's title for a whole-report drill (empty group key) fell back to `String(reportData.label)`, which reads `[object Object]`.

Each now resolves the map in the viewer's language (`useObjectTranslation().language`) with `metadataText`, the app-shell reader the app's report index (`useAppReportEntries`) and recent items already name a report with. It is the spec's `resolveI18nLabel`, which agrees limb for limb with `pickLocalized` (the resolver the objectui#13380 fix used) and spells a miss `undefined`, so the existing fallbacks (`'Report Viewer'`, the humanized slug, the report name) keep working through `??`. A plain-string label or description draws exactly as before. One changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

The other surfaces that print a report's label or description were checked and already resolve the map: the app's report index (`AppReportIndexView`) and the ⌘K palette's app-report rows both read `useAppReportEntries`, which calls `metadataText`. The palette's navigation rows print the navigation entry's own label, not the report's.

## Tests

New pins, both mounting the real component under a real `I18nProvider`, each leg in `en` and `zh-CN`, with a plain-string report as the control:

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.inlineLocaleLabel-13470.test.tsx`: the card's repro report, with the map on both `label` and `description`. Legs `HEADING_MAP_RESOLVES`, `DESCRIPTION_MAP_RESOLVES`, `DRILL_TITLE_MAP_RESOLVES`, `PLAIN_STRING_CONTROL`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.reportCrumbInlineLocale-13470.test.tsx`: the `AppHeader.dashboardReportCrumb-12273` harness with `useObjectLabel` real. Legs `LABEL_MAP_RESOLVES`, `PLAIN_STRING_CONTROL`.

Readings, all at head `899902d`:

- The two new files: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 12 passed (12).
- Every test file that imports `ReportView`, `AppHeader`, `AppReportIndexView` or `appReportIndex` (39 files, found by `git grep` over test files), with `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 39 passed (39), Tests 323 passed (323).
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --concurrency=2`: 30 successful, 30 total. The package's `type-check` chains `tsconfig.test.json`, so both new test files are type-checked.
- eslint on the four touched files: 0 errors. The 44 warnings are on lines this PR does not change.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: pass (1 changeset for 1 released package). `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations. `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: pass.

Narrowed, declared: the whole `packages/app-shell/` suite at `--maxWorkers=2` printed nothing for 60 minutes on this shared container and was stopped, so it is NOT MEASURED locally; CI's sharded `pnpm test` runs it. The narrowed set is every test that imports a changed module. Its blind spot: a test that mounts these components through another import path without naming them.

Ablation, one site at a time on the committed fix. Each leg put the pre-fix line back, ran the two new files, then restored the file with `git checkout HEAD` and confirmed `git diff HEAD` was empty:

- heading reverted: 6 failed, 6 passed. Every map leg of the `ReportView` file fails on `Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {zh-CN, en})`; the control legs and the crumb file pass.
- description reverted: 6 failed, 6 passed, the same error.
- drill title reverted: 2 failed, 10 passed. Only `DRILL_TITLE_MAP_RESOLVES` fails, in both languages, and the drawer reads `[object Object]`.
- crumb reverted: 2 failed, 10 passed. Only the crumb file's `LABEL_MAP_RESOLVES` legs fail, on the same React error #31.

## Acceptance notes

- Same defect on the page route, measured, not fixed here (outside this card's file surface): `AppHeader`'s page branch hands `pageDef.label` to `pageLabel` as its fallback the same way, and `PageSchema.label` is `I18nLabel` too. A throwaway probe (not committed) mounted this PR's crumb harness at `/apps/srm/page/welcome` with that page's label set to `{ 'zh-CN', en }`: it fails on `Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {zh-CN, en})`, so a page with an inline-map label blanks its route. Handed to the seat to file.
- `DatasetReportRenderer`'s `resolveText` (the heading of each block of a `joined` report) reads only a map's `default` entry, so a block label written as `{ 'zh-CN', en }` shows the block's name instead of either string. Read-only observation from the code, not measured; nothing filed.
- `ReportView` still reads `previewReport.title` before `label`. `ReportSchema` declares no root `title`, so the arm reads a key no valid document carries (the dashboard view retired its twin under ADR-0049). Left as it was, now resolved like `label`; outside this card.
- The report crumb still passes through the `reports.NAME.label` bundle lookup (`reportLabel`), while the page heading draws the served label as given. That split predates this PR and is unchanged.
